description: AI Cycle Monitor: the AI Capex Pulse, a monthly gauge of the AI investment cycle on the 50 line (50 = average growth since 2012, 10 points = 1 standard deviation) built from chips, chipmaking equipment and server output/trade/revenue (Fed industrial production, Census orders, UN Comtrade, TSMC and Taiwan server makers' filings) and data-centre build-out (Census data-centre construction, electricity in data-centre states, electrical equipment orders, hyperscaler capex from SEC filings). Returns the headline with history, the two pillars, every component (latest y/y growth and signal), economy readings (us, tw, kr, jp, nl, my), adoption indicators (US firms using AI, AI job postings by country, AI search interest, AI bot traffic), AI equity baskets vs world equities, and the correlation with later US IT investment. Give economy for one economy's reading and components.

description: War & Conflict Monitor: the War & Conflict Index, a monthly measure of organised violence (wars, insurgencies, armed-group fighting, attacks on civilians) for 47 economies, their regions and the world, from two components, the higher of which sets the reading: deaths (Uppsala Conflict Data Program, 25 points per tenfold rise in monthly deaths, 100 = 10,000+ a month; deaths abroad involving the state's forces count half) and strikes (GDELT reports of air strikes, missiles, drones, bombings and artillery, fatal or not, vs the economy's own 2015-2019 normal: 3x = 25, 6x = 50, 12x = 75). 0 = no organised violence; bands None/Low/Elevated/High/War. Violence only: no geopolitical tension or threat measures. Returns the reading, deaths at home and abroad, main conflicts, history, a military operations tempo gauge (news reports of combat operations by its own forces, with theatres abroad; not in the index), the defence economy (US defence orders/output/spending, European defence spending % GDP, aerospace & defence stocks), a shipping-spillover panel (not in the index) and a pooled test of GDP growth and nowcast misses by conflict level. Give economy (ru, ng, mx, ...) or an aggregate slug (world, latin-america-caribbean, ...).

description: World Sector Activity Index: monthly readings on the 50 line (50 = as many firms report rising as falling) by GICS-aligned sector, industry group, industry and sub-industry, for the World, regions (EUROPE, NAMERICA) and countries (EU, EA, US, DE, FR, IT, ES, ...). Built from national business surveys (European Commission NACE subsectors; US Census Business Trends and Outlook Survey) through worldgdp.org's own classification crosswalk. Measures: out (output), new (new orders), emp (employment), fut (future activity), px (prices charged). Default readings are bias-adjusted (each series centred on its own long-run average so countries compare like for like); set adjusted=false for raw survey readings.
